The drawnRect correction hides a real failure. tests/native-screens.js converts the ruler to drawn px but not caret.top from coordsAtPos, which is zoomed space (proved by the 24 layout px paragraph pitch at both zooms). True clearance at the page 150 state (zoom 0.843): caret 125.17, ruler bottom 134.23, -9 px, report says +14. App cause: ProseMirror compares raw caret rect with the unzoomed scroller, and Writer.tsx's margin is 29 at any zoom; that model reproduces the measured scroll moves within 1 px. Inferred: holding Up at zoom 0.75 hides the line wholly. Sticky 300 vs 600 and sheets are correct. Next: convert caret.top, fix place(), fix the unawaited ArrowRight loop that leaves the sidebar at 520 px (page 100 and 150 both drew at 0.843, page above zoom 1 never measured), decide the app fix (handleScrollToSelection), rerun, fill the native list item by item. Also visible: Manuscript and Fragments both bold with a fragment on screen (activeDestination in ProjectSidebar.tsx). VALIDATION Native run corrected; full findings in REVIEW-r3.md, T242.
